title: dactylorhiza traunsteineri subsp. deweveri
intro: Dactylorhiza traunsteineri subsp. deweveri, commonly known as the Balkan orchid, is a subspecies of orchid plant belonging to the Dactylorhiza genus. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Balkan orchid are attributed to its ability to stimulate the cardiovascular system, improve blood circulation, and exhibit antioxidant and cytoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of Balkan orchid include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being researched for their potential therapeutic applications.
